Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: editorial illustration for a beautifully designed simplified graph-engineering PDF guide.
Primary request: a refined physical sculpture of a small computational graph, several rounded porcelain nodes joined by slender bent cylindrical connectors, one circular loop nested within the larger network. Clearly built, tactile and architectural rather than digital neon.
Scene/backdrop: seamless warm ivory studio surface.
Style/medium: premium 3D editorial still life, matte ceramic and powder-coated metal, beautifully rendered subtle material grain.
Composition/framing: square image; entire sculpture visible with generous breathing room, sculptural asymmetry and interesting negative space, three-quarter overhead view. Object centered for use on a right-hand book-cover panel.
Lighting/mood: soft directional daylight, precise long soft shadows, quiet sophistication.
Color palette: deep petrol teal nodes, warm ivory surfaces, a small vermilion connector accent.
Constraints: no letters, no numbers, no text, no logo, no watermark. A simple small network, not a dense hairball. This is an artistic illustration, not a labeled technical diagram.
